description.value: JJ's Restaurant is a student-run teaching restaurant at Vancouver Community College where second-level culinary students prepare and serve a three-course a la carte lunch under the guidance of Chef Instructors. The experience offers gourmet cuisine at accessible prices in a formal dining room setting inside VCC's downtown Vancouver campus. Dietary restrictions can be accommodated with advance notice, making it a distinctive lunch option in the heart of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms JJ's Restaurant is a real, operating student-run teaching restaurant inside VCC's downtown campus at 250 West Pender Street, serving a three-course a la carte lunch prepared by culinary students. The OSM record had no phone number, but the website explicitly provides 604.443.8479 for reservations. Neither OSM tags nor website content mention any cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms), so those are all null.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; website provides 604.443.8479 — used website value.
Restaurant is located on level 2 (floor 3 per level:ref) inside the VCC building; cyclists must bring bikes inside or leave them outside unattended.
Operating window is extremely narrow (weekday lunches only per OSM opening_hours); touring cyclists may find it hard to plan around. Not grounds for exclusion but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating restaurant at a public college campus, confirmed via website. Open to the public and a distinctive dining option for cyclists in downtown Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Reservations via OpenTable or by phone for groups of nine or more. Dietary restrictions accommodated with advance notice via culinaryarts@vcc.ca. This is primarily a teaching kitchen, not a commercial restaurant.
